action.objective: Commit the verified developing move Be3, improving the dark-square bishop and preparing castling.
action.rationale: c1e3 is the only commit_ready move: verified at effective depth 4 with an exact score of 6 and a PV of Be3/Bb4/Rb1. Safety is complete with no mating reply and tactical_refutation not_found, though that probe covers only checking replies and quiet or longer threats remain outside its scope. Its bound is exact, not upper, so the score is not merely a ceiling. No proven refutations exist and unavoidable_mate is false. Be3 develops a minor, keeps the king safe, and avoids the unverified alternatives. Broad search ranked it top; the earlier suggestion c1g5 had only an upper bound, which could be much worse. Committing c1e3 is the strongest evidence-based choice.
